policies.name: Standard booking
policies.policyText: Please give us at least 24 hours’ notice to move or cancel a pickup. We send a reminder the day before and two hours ahead, and we’ll always text you a heads-up when the crew is on the way.

policies.name: Same-day priority
policies.policyText: Same-day pickups are booked into the next open crew window and confirmed by text. If plans change, let us know as soon as you can so we can offer the slot to someone else.

services.name: Free pickup quote
services.description: A free, no-pressure look — in person or by photo — at what you need gone. We’ll tell you what can be donated, what we can recycle, and give you a flat, upfront price before anything moves.

services.name: Donation pickup
services.description: Gently-used furniture, clothing, housewares and more, collected and driven straight to local charities and shelters. Still good? It gets a second home, not a dumpster — and you get the donation receipt.

services.name: Recycling haul
services.description: Metal, cardboard, wood, appliances and mixed materials sorted and taken to the right recycler — not the landfill. We break it down, separate it, and divert as much as the facilities near you will take.

services.name: E-waste removal
services.description: Old computers, TVs, monitors, cables and batteries handled by our certified e-waste crew and taken to a responsible processor — data-bearing drives noted, nothing dumped or shipped offshore.

services.name: Furniture removal
services.description: Couches, mattresses, desks and the heavy things you can’t lift alone — carried out for you, then donated if they’re usable and recycled if they’re not. No stairs, no problem.

services.name: Cleanout consult
services.description: Planning a garage, estate, office or whole-home clearout? A free walkthrough to scope the job, sort what can be saved from what can’t, and map out a donation-first plan with a clear, flat quote.

services.name: Same-day pickup
services.description: Need it gone today? When a crew has an open window, we’ll come the same day — same donation-first, minimal-landfill promise, just faster. Book it and we’ll confirm your slot by text.
